kpis.description_fr: ARR consolidé (subscriptions Creo CAD + Windchill PLM + Codebeamer + Onshape + ServiceMax). Pivot SaaS-first.
kpis.description_en: Consolidated ARR (Creo CAD + Windchill PLM + Codebeamer + Onshape + ServiceMax subscriptions). SaaS-first pivot.

kpis.description_fr: ARR Creo (mécanique CAD). Concurrence Solidworks, NX. Croissance stable.
kpis.description_en: Creo ARR (mechanical CAD). Solidworks, NX competition. Stable growth.

kpis.description_fr: ARR Windchill PLM (product lifecycle management). Marché PLM strong tailwind digital transformation.
kpis.description_en: Windchill PLM ARR. Strong PLM market tailwind from digital transformation.

kpis.description_fr: ARR pure-SaaS (Onshape browser CAD + Arena cloud PLM). Croissance forte, leaders cloud-native.
kpis.description_en: Pure-SaaS ARR (Onshape browser CAD + Arena cloud PLM). Strong growth, cloud-native leaders.

kpis_story.description_fr: Acquisition ServiceMax (1.46Md$, 2023) : field service management cloud. Extension portefeuille CLM. Cross-sell base Windchill.
kpis_story.description_en: ServiceMax acquisition ($1.46B, 2023): cloud field service management. CLM portfolio extension. Cross-sell to Windchill base.

_notes: PTC = CAD + PLM industrial software. Fiscal year fin septembre.
